units.source_text: 古歌：“君衣香可恋，遗恨不能亲。

en.t: An old poem says: The fragrance of your robes is dear to me, yet I grieve that I cannot draw near to you.

units.source_text: 只为梅香似，折来聊慰情。”

en.t: Only because the scent of plum blossoms resembles it, I break off a branch and bring it here to soothe my longing a little.
This poem appears in the Collection of Gleanings.

units.source_text: 引此歌，指匂亲王的衣香。

en.t: The poem is quoted here to refer to the fragrance of Prince Niou's robes.
